statement: Complete Stage A1-A4 key ordering, persisted boundary representation, declared primary-key resolution, and compound primary-key narrowing with zero legacy or fallback logic: PartitionSplitMergeManager.comparePartitionKeys delegates to compareRoutingKeys, finite numeric comparisons avoid subtraction overflow, unsupported/absent keys validate before equality, PARTITIONS_SCHEMA and split/merge/create workflows persist and validate partition_key_type with 64-bit BigInt median precision, compareNumberWithTextEncodedNumber and 'id' primary-key fallbacks are removed across all resolvers/coordinators/live-query owners, and compound primary keys route and narrow with exact tuple comparison, AND-bound intersection, and NOT IN scatter safety.
